items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for new public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance baseline has 35 passes, 20 fails, and 6 unknowns across 61 checked sites; open findings include banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms controls. Security and operations sweeps are unevidenced. Revenue evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not approve go-live or rights-dependent monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced closed; all four remain open. Existing partial evidence covers repository/configuration files and draft privacy/cookie/terms pages, but not authoritative rights, retention, consent settings, vendor coverage, or jurisdictional review. Next evidence action: produce the read-only SearchWoot data-flow and retention table from repository and deployed configuration, covering alert rules, identifiers, sync results, Slack/email delivery, retention, deletion, correction, access, and unsubscribe behavior.

Private and parked properties require a concrete disposition: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No build, publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared until dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence is attached.

Do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete. Permit bounded reversible work only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift from the aggregate affiliate row.
